item.name: Fisherman Island
item.access: Default spawn. Also known as Stingray Shores.
item.keyServices: Rod shop, bobber shop, boat shop, fish selling, rod skin spins, Utility Store (diving gear).
item.notableCatches: Clownfish, Azure Damsel, Dotted Stingray, Crystal Crab, Orca
item.cardSummary: The starting island and main service hub. Buy rods, bobbers, and boats here, sell catches, and set out for every other fishing zone.

item.name: Ocean
item.access: Cast while sailing between islands. Markers appear once you leave Fisherman Island by boat.
item.keyServices: No shops. Pure open-water fishing between island routes.
item.notableCatches: Manta Ray, Hammerhead Shark, Chrome Tuna, Ghost Shark, Megalodon
item.cardSummary: The open water between islands with its own fish index. Stop and fish while traveling instead of only casting at island piers.

item.name: Tropical Grove
item.access: Boat west of Fisherman Island toward the island marker.
item.keyServices: Rod shop and fish selling. Strong Enchant Stone farming spot.
item.notableCatches: Great Whale, Thresher Shark, Pufferfish, King Mackerel
item.cardSummary: A nearby early island for solid coin runs and Enchant Stone grinding. Easy boat ride from the starter hub.

item.name: Kohana Island
item.access: Boat north from Fisherman Island to the waterfall island marker.
item.keyServices: Rod shop and fish selling. Entrance to Kohana Volcano is on this island.
item.notableCatches: Prismy Seahorse, Loggerhead Turtle, Lobster, Lochness Monster
item.cardSummary: Mid-game island with shops and the path into Kohana Volcano. Fill the Kohana index here, then move into the lava pool for farming.

item.name: Kohana Volcano
item.access: On Kohana Island, enter the cave or mountain route near the village and waterfall. Do not jump off the volcano rim.
item.keyServices: Lava Fisherman NPC grants a free Lava Rod. Lava pools for fishing.
item.notableCatches: Blueflame Ray, Magma Shark, Lavafin Tuna, Magma Goby
item.cardSummary: The lava fishing pool inside Kohana. Claim the free Lava Rod and farm valuable volcanic fish for fast coin progression.

item.name: Coral Reefs
item.access: Boat to the northwest island marker. Fish near the cave entrance decorated with purple crystals.
item.notableCatches: Monster Shark, Eerie Shark, Hawks Turtle, Blue Lobster, Pink Dolphin
item.cardSummary: A colorful mid-game island with a strong index, including secret sharks. Cast in the crystal cave for efficient sessions.

item.name: Crater Island
item.access: Boat to the Crater Island map marker.
item.notableCatches: Axolotl, Catfish, Sheepshead Fish, Coney Fish, Silver Tuna
item.cardSummary: A standard mid-map island for filling another regional index. Solid shop support, moderate fish values versus volcano or dive zones.

item.name: Esoteric Depths
item.access: Pay the elevator fee (about 400 coins), ride down, and fish the small underground pool.
item.keyServices: Enchant Altar for applying Enchant Stones to rods. Strong Enchant Stone catch rates near the altar.
item.notableCatches: Abyss Seahorse, Brown Megalodon, Armored Shark, Magic Tang, Enchanted Angelfish
item.cardSummary: A gated underground island for enchanting rods and farming high-value magical fish. Bring stones here to power up gear.

item.name: Lost Isle
item.access: Boat to the northern map edge until the Lost Isle marker appears. Surface rock has a dive staging area.
item.requirements: Boat. Diving gear for the underwater fishing pools.
item.keyServices: Surface staging for dive gear. Underwater path to Sisyphus Statue, Treasure Room, and the Angler Rod shop temple.
item.notableCatches: Deep-sea Secrets across its underwater rooms (see Sisyphus Statue and Treasure Room)
item.cardSummary: The remote northern dive region that unlocks endgame underwater fishing. Equip diving gear on the surface island, then descend into its secret pools.

item.name: Sisyphus Statue
item.access: From Lost Isle, dive and swim into the large underwater temple past the waterfall-like doorway.
item.requirements: Diving gear (about 75,000 coins from the Utility Store on Fisherman Island, or gifted)
item.keyServices: Deep Sea Quest progress toward Ghostfinn Rod. Nearby mini-temple sells the Angler Rod.
item.notableCatches: Robot Kraken, Giant Squid, Panther Eel, Blob Fish, Cryoshade Glider
item.cardSummary: The main Lost Isle underwater temple pool packed with secret-tier deep-sea fish. High luck gear is required for practical farming.

item.name: Treasure Room
item.access: From Lost Isle, dive into the deeper chasm and pass the waterfall doorway into the Treasure Hall, then the Treasure Room pool.
item.keyServices: Deep Sea Quest fishing targets. No surface shops inside the room.
item.notableCatches: King Crab, Queen Crab, Kraken, Blob Fish, Antique Watch
item.cardSummary: The deepest Lost Isle fishing room, best known for crab and kraken secrets. A prime late-game money and index destination with strong gear.

item.name: Ancient Jungle
item.access: Boat to the Ancient Jungle island marker.
item.requirements: Boat. Artifacts and levers open the temple. Some side areas are night-only.
item.keyServices: Island shops for newer rods, bobbers, and boats. Temple unlock route for secret rooms.
item.notableCatches: Ancient Arapaima, Manoai Statue Fish, Temple Spokes Tuna, Goliath Tiger, Skeleton Angler Fish
item.cardSummary: A late permanent island with jungle fish and hidden temples. Collect artifacts around the island to open deeper fishing rooms.

item.name: Sacred Temple
item.access: On Ancient Jungle, fish four color-coded artifact spots (radar helps), place them at levers to open the temple. Underground Cellar entrance is right of the temple door and opens at night.
item.requirements: Temple artifacts and puzzles. Night access for the Underground Cellar path.
item.keyServices: Elemental or Element Rod quests and high-value temple fishing. Cellar traps lead to a closed fishing pool.
item.notableCatches: Temple Spokes Tuna, Manoai Statue Fish, Spear Guardian, Ancient Relic Crocodile
item.cardSummary: The Ancient Jungle temple and cellar rooms behind artifact puzzles. Use this area for elite temple fish and the Elemental Rod questline.

item.name: Pirate Cove
item.access: Boat to Pirate Cove after the January 12, 2026 Pirate Cove update. Permanent map island.
item.keyServices: Island NPCs and quests (Carpenter, Captain Jones, Dead Skeleton). Free event-pass style progression on the permanent island.
item.notableCatches: Pirate Dreadfin, Pirate Sailfish, Treasure Crab, Captain Pufferfish, and other Pirate Cove-index fish
item.cardSummary: A permanent late island with pirate-themed fish and quest NPCs. Also the surface hub for Crystal Depths and the Pirate Treasure Room.

item.name: Crystal Depths
item.access: On Pirate Cove, buy Advanced Diving Gear, then take the rope at the island center down into the sea floor area.
item.keyServices: Dorian and Hank underwater quests. Large unique fish index in the depths.
item.notableCatches: 20+ unique Crystal Depths fish unique to this underwater route
item.cardSummary: Pirate Cove’s central rope dive into a crystal underwater zone. Needs Advanced Diving Gear and hosts a large exclusive fish set.

item.name: Pirate Treasure Room
item.access: On Pirate Cove, finish the Carpenter TNT quest, blow open the rock pile, dive into the cave, clear the maze room, then enter the Pirate Treasure Room.
item.requirements: Carpenter quest and TNT. Diving gear for the cave swim.
item.keyServices: Secret pirate treasure fishing room. Separate from Lost Isle’s Treasure Room.
item.notableCatches: Pirate Treasure Room exclusive high-rarity and secret-tier fish
item.cardSummary: Pirate Cove’s quest-gated underwater treasure room behind TNT, a dive cave, and a maze. A late secret destination distinct from Lost Isle’s Treasure Room.
